caveat: Timeframe alignment is descriptive. A conflict between timeframes is the normal state of a market, not an error, and alignment has not been shown to precede better returns.
narrative: 1w: transition, mid range · 1d: bullish, near range top · 4h: range, mid range · 1h: range, mid range · 15m: range, above range. The higher timeframe holds a direction while a lower one consolidates - a pause inside a move rather than a disagreement.

timeframes.invalidation: A 1w close outside 1312.53-4123.76 would invalidate the current range reading.
A 1d close above 2579.94 would break the range top zone and invalidate the current range reading.
A 4h close outside 2348.55-2547.86 would invalidate the current range reading.
A 1h close outside 2367.59-2539.57 would invalidate the current range reading.
A 15m close back below 2502.93 would mean the breakout failed and price has reintegrated the range.
